hypotheses.G0_pooled_rank32_matches_target_specific: Pooled rank-32 fidelity is within 0.05 of target-specific rank-32 fidelity for every target/corpus.
hypotheses.G1_pooled_rank64_is_broadly_sufficient: Pooled rank-64 fidelity is >=0.70 for every target/corpus.
hypotheses.G2_common_channel_bank_matches_target_sp: Pooled top-128 channel fidelity is within 0.05 of target-specific top-128 fidelity for every target/corpus.
hypotheses.G3_pooled_backbone_beats_random: At rank 32, pooled fidelity exceeds equal-rank random-subspace fidelity by >=0.30 for every target/corpus.
hypotheses.G4_one_shared_native_bank_is_useful: Pooled top-256 channels reach fidelity >=0.60 for every target/corpus.
